qualification.details: Pediatrician / Medical Officer: MBBS with MD/DNB/Diploma in Paediatrics for Paediatrician. For Medical Officer: MBBS from a recognized medical institution, registered with the Telangana State Medical Council/NMC as applicable. Staff Nurse: GNM / B.Sc. Nursing from a recognized institution and valid registration with Telangana Nurses & Midwives Council. 2nd ANM: ANM / MPHW (Female) qualification from a recognized institution and valid registration with Telangana State Nurses & Midwives Council. Lab Technician: DMLT / B.Sc. Medical Laboratory Technology (B.Sc. MLT) or equivalent recognized qualification and valid registration with Telangana Paramedical Board, wherever applicable. Anaesthetist: MBBS + MD/DNB in Anaesthesiology or Postgraduate Diploma in Anaesthesiology, from a recognized institution, with valid medical registration. OBG Specialist: MBBS + MD/MS/DNB in Obstetrics & Gynaecology or recognized PG Diploma in Obstetrics & Gynaecology, with valid medical registration. MLHP / CHO / MO - Palle Dawakhana: MLHP/CHO: BAMS / B.Sc. Nursing / B.Sc. Community Health / equivalent qualification as prescribed under the applicable programme guidelines. MO: MBBS with valid medical registration. Physician / MBBS / MD: MBBS with valid medical registration. Where the post specifically requires a Specialist/Physician: MD/DNB in General Medicine / Family Medicine or equivalent recognized qualification. ANM: ANM / MPHW (Female) qualification from a recognized institution and valid registration with Telangana State Nurses & Midwives Council.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for DMHO Wanaparthy Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: wanaparthy.telangana.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 09-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the District Medical & Health Office Wanaparthy (DMHO Wanaparthy) for filling various contractual positions under the National Health Mission (NHM) in Telangana.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available in this notification?
faq.answer: There are a total of 27 vacancies available across various posts including Pediatrician, Medical Officer, Staff Nurse, Lab Technician, Anaesthetist, OBG Specialist, and more.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application for DMHO Wanaparthy recruitment?
faq.answer: The applications must be submitted in offline mode only. Candidates need to download the form, fill it, attach necessary certificates, and send it by post or submit in person.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date for receiving filled-in offline application forms is 09 October 2026. Candidates must ensure their applications reach the office well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q5. What are the age limits for these contractual posts?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement is 18 years and the maximum age limit is 44 years. Age relaxations are applicable for SC, ST, BC, EWS, Ex-Servicemen, NCC, and PWD candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What educational qualifications are required to apply?
faq.answer: Qualifications vary by post, ranging from ANM, GNM, B.Sc. Nursing, DMLT, B.Sc. MLT to specialized medical degrees like MBBS, BAMS, MD, DNB, and PG Diplomas in clinical fields.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for general candidates?
faq.answer: Yes, the application fee is Rupees 300/- for General candidates (OC and BC), while SC/ST candidates are required to pay Rupees 200/- as application fee.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process is based on a merit list prepared according to the marks obtained in the qualifying examinations (90 marks) and age points (10 marks), following reservation rules.

faq.question: Q9. Where should the filled application form be sent?
faq.answer: Candidates must submit their completed offline application forms either in person or through registered post/speed post to the respective District Medical & Health Officer of Wanaparthy district.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I download the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: You can download the official notification PDF, application format, and other details by visiting the official website of the district or through the direct links provided in this article.
